newsitem.title: USA: Daw Technologies sees downturn continuing.
newsitem.headline: Daw Technologies sees downturn continuing.

text.p: Daw Technologies Inc on Monday said it expected to see an industry downturn effect its financial results through the second and possibly the third quarter of 1997.

"The current semiconductor industry downturn has had a significant impact on the company's financial results for the first quarter of 1997," said Ronald Daw, president and chief executive of the company, citing lower revenues and earnings.
Daw Technologies reported first quarter net earnings of $182,000 or $0.01 per share, compared with $618,000 or $0.05 pershare for the same quarter of 1996.
"We think that the industry downturn will continue to impact the financial results of the company through the second and possibly the third quarter," he added.
He also said that the company's management team had taken steps to reduce costs.
Daw Technologies Inc provides ultraclean manufacturing environments and specializes in the design and installation of cleanrooms to meet semiconductor manufacturing requirements.
